angu_curator.text: Welcome to the Revolution Museum. On 30 May 1967 the people of Anguilla sent the St Kitts police home. The island declared itself a republic in 1969. Britain sent in paratroopers and police.
Nobody was killed. The press called it the Bay of Piglets. In 1980 Anguilla became a separate British territory, which was what the people had wanted all along.

angu_veteran.text: I was there in sixty-seven. We told the police boat to go home. It went. We were quite surprised.
Everyone had an opinion, a boat or a goat. We needed all three.
